newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's premier calls for strong Arab trade ties.
newsitem.headline: Malta's premier calls for strong Arab trade ties.

text.p: Maltese Prime Minister Alfred Sant on Tuesday called for strengthening trade cooperation between Malta and Arab countries.
"We are working hard to make a concrete success out of our relations with the European Union. We should also work hard to make a concrete success out of our relations with the Arab world," he said.
Sant made the remarks to the Maltese-Arab Chamber of Commerce in Valletta. Malta-Arab trade links are currently almost exclusively with neighbouring Libya.

The Libyan Arab Foreign Investment Company (LAFICO) is a shareholder in the Libyan Arab Maltese Holding Company which has shares in 14 companies in Malta, including a leading hotel, a shipbuilding yard and a small airline.
LAFICO said on November it intended setting up a joint stock company to invest $50 million in joint ventures in Malta.
